# COBOL — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created COBOL?", "Grace Hopper et al."),
    ("What paradigm is COBOL?", "procedural"),
    ("What is creator?", "Grace Hopper et al."),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1959"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "procedural"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".cbl"),
    ("What is hello world?", "DISPLAY \"Hello, world!\"."),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
